entries.answer: A year has 365 days, and 366 days in a leap year.

questions: what is the speed of light
entries.answer: Light travels at about 299,792 kilometers per second in a vacuum.

questions: what is the speed of sound
entries.answer: Sound travels at about 343 meters per second in air at 20 degrees Celsius.

entries.answer: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius, or 212 degrees Fahrenheit, at sea level.
